content: Dakul mwamov-wan
Bweina kupiyaves sinap kalbaleb, kameiliw, silponay, katidividav, silakod, wutokay livan.
Kadiloka ninoumiy kuva̱ges ma̱wan a̱pwaw yakamiy, va̱gan beivag sivinamiy sus bwanabwein silma̱nin kululuwamiy bitawtoun; bukumoums mo kululuwamiy bitubwes Yowbad nakatuneib silma̱nin.
Bo kusimkwanes daGuyaws nasiwa̱youb wasigeis yakamiy.
Kunekes Yeisuw, mtowen mamagina wululay, mwamov-wan. Gamag mwasanin bo ipiyaves, tage Yowbad singay sivinan; peinan bo ikatigik silma̱nin inawotet.

Yakamiy ma̱wana wululay mwamov yakamiy, bweina kululuwamiy biwlul mamagina nabunatum, mamagina natalineiluns bwana̱bweins yakamiy, mo Yeisuw Kelis bilabeimiy va̱gan Yowbad beitam amilun waseg, mamagina kululuwamiy waseg bukuluns.
Livan nises Bukitab waseg mamagina:

content.text: “Bo batamnow gunkakol ven Sayon waseg, kakol bwana-bwein bo akatigik silma̱nin sol.
Kukin kal bisimounid waseg gamag towen nag beivag anmwasin.”

content: Yakamiy tasimounid sivinamiy gamag towen, tage tasiyas nag isimounids, livnes nises mamagina:

content.text: “Wululay towen tawteleins bunatum nipiyaves; tage bo imlavag anmwamwan bunatum.”

content: Kweitan-vak livan mamagina:

content.text: “Gamag bikatpines kikeis wululay towen mo bikalouws.”

content: Bo bikalivatows peinan isiplaves anilivan. Yowbad bo ilivnek ma̱wan.

Yakamiy gog Yowbad nikatigikeimiy angamag yakamiy, yakamiy tanuwgwes lun silma̱nin guyaw towen, yakamiy inabod bwanabwein, yakamiy Yowbad inagamag tatonen. Miwotet bukwamteles ama̱wan nikatigikeimiy tadadubs yakamiy, mo kusiws nakamnat avakaein waseg. E, bukwamteles nasiwa̱youb towen avakaein.
Kweiboug nag kweitan bod yakamiy, tage nagein bo nukumlavags Yowbad angamag yakamiy. Kweiboug nag inok nuwan yakamiy, nagein gog inok nuwan, ikatinabweimiy.
Yowbad natouwat yakamiy
Sigwey, kadiloka kwatibomes woumiy anvikeiy, peinan biyageg kululuwamiy, peinan yakamiy mamagina taggobwaws yakamiy, o bwabwal yakamiy.
Beivag amisinap bwein wamtes tadadubs. Magat bivtokeimiy livan peinan bidokeimiy takalbalebs yakamiy, tage bikines miwotet bwanabwein, o yam towen Yowbad bilakwaneimiy mo biya̱kawns Yowbad waseg.
DaGuyaws angamag yakamiy, bweina bukutams waseg kaleiwag babaw ven watinow, magat tavakaein towen king, o takinew gabman tasiyas nikayabes silma̱nin bimapus takalbalebs o bikavasis tasiyas toubweins.
Yowbad sivinan beivag amisinap kamnat, mo bikineimiy tasiyas tatagouwaws, asilivan kabala̱wein; tage bikineimiy amisinap bwein, mo bika̱pays.
Awoum beivag amisinap ma̱wana tasiwun deil yakamiy, peinan yakamiy kunounas wamnat, ampalawen sivinamiy; tage awoum kunounas ked kalbaleb waseg, peinan Yowbad natouwat yakamiy.
Kuvna̱ses gamag babaw. Kusiwyoubus tasiyas tayekelesiys. Kugoulus Yowbad. Kuvna̱ses mtowen takaleiwag king avakaein.
Kelis a̱ban igeg ven watinow waseg
Touwats yakamiy, kugoulus mituwa̱veks o kwanawes ages, takinew mituwa̱veks tasiwa̱youbs o tamma̱nums, o takinew tayakeikays tasiyas, bweina bukwanawes ages.
Kukin kal toubwein, mwasanis gamag biyagages makaw, a̱ban bigeg, tage binuway Yowbad, bikaptul, mo Yowbad bidok bwanabwein gamag towen.
Tage kukin amsinap kalbaleb mapuna biwaweims mo bukwaptuleim, nag amsinap bwanabwein towen, nag. Kukin gog amsinap bwein mo biyagageims o bukwaptuleim, Yowbad mo bidokeim gamag bwanabwein ya̱koum.
Ked towen silma̱nin Yowbad nikatigikeids, Kelis gog igeg a̱ban peinads, waseg ikatimlakeids ama̱wan bitabwa̱kuns waseg.
Nag ivag ansinap kalbaleb. Nag ikatidavis gamag, nag.
Tasiyas niyyages Yeisuw, tage nag ikatimop asilivan. A̱ban igeg, tage nag ikananeiy. Bo inamis waseg Yowbad, peinan ikakina Yowbad nakaleiwag didumwal.

Yeisuw anmwa̱net ikow adsinaps kalbaleb wakamweilok, won tatonen ikanig, va̱gan sinap kalbaleb bikanig wanuwads ya̱kids, wankuyeim mo bitamwamovs silma̱nin sinap didumwal. Ibasis won Yeisuw, mapuna ya̱kids tasesus bwein.
Kweiboug ya̱kids ma̱wana sip talasisulin ked, tage bo nitayums tanekes datamtakavatays mtowen takaymatein kululuwads.
